title: Team and invitations
description: Who can sign in to this workspace, what they may do, and who is still invited.
forbiddenTitle: Only owners and managers can see the team
forbiddenBody: Ask an owner or manager if you need to add someone or change a role.
loadFailBody: Refresh the page. If it keeps happening, tell us.
membersDesc: {count} people with access to this workspace.
confirmRemoveBody: They lose access to this workspace. Their past work and messages stay.
confirmDisableBody: They cannot sign in to this workspace until you enable them again.
invitesDesc: People who have been invited but have not joined yet.
inviteRotateNote: Creating a link replaces the previous one. Share only the newest.
formDesc: They get an email with a link to join. You can also copy the link and send it yourself.
staffHint: Link to a staff member you already added, so their name and assignments become this account.
sentNoEmail: Invitation created for {email}. The email could not be sent, so copy the link below and send it yourself.
sentNoticeExisting: {email} already has an account. We sent a sign-in link; they can also use the link below.
errAlreadyMember: This person is already a member.
errStaffTaken: That staff member is already linked to an account or a pending invitation.
errLastOwner: A workspace needs at least one active owner.
errSelf: You cannot do this to your own account.
errNotAllowed: Only an owner can change an owner.
errNotFound: That member or invitation no longer exists.
errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
